output.description: Output file path; if empty, output goes to stdout.

debug.description: Enable debug output (minification time & compression efficiency).

optimizations.description: Optimization level (0, 1, 2) or a fine-grained options string (e.g., 'removeQuotes:off;roundingPrecision:4').

inline_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for fetching remote stylesheets during inlining.

remove_inlined_files.description: Remove files inlined via @import or command-line after processing.

source_map_inline_sources.description: Inline source content in source maps.

input_source_map.description: Path to input source map file for rebase and sourcemap handling.
